name: Adnan Khan
biography: Adnan is a Red Team Security Engineer and researcher who has recently been focusing on supply chain and CI/CD attacks. He has identified, demonstrated, and reported vulnerabilities impacting GitHub repositories belonging to organizations like Microsoft, Nvidia, GitHub, Google, and more. Additionally, he has spoken at conferences such as ShmooCon 2023 and BSides SF 2023 on the topic of GitHub Actions security.
